assumed.distortion: coefficients are plausible placeholders, not measured
assumed.intrinsics: 33661's values used for all ten cameras
assumed.noise: independent zero-mean Gaussian per image axis, same on every camera
assumed.visibility: geometric only: on sensor, in front, inside FOV. No occlusion, no marker size/brightness falloff with range

provenance.floor_note: These numbers assume PERFECT calibration (exact intrinsics and extrinsics). Real accuracy will be worse because calibrated extrinsics carry their own error. This is a floor, not a forecast. For scale: the previous rig measured 13.8 mm loop closure over a 9 m circuit.

sensitivity.verdict: ROBUST: median/p90 error varies by at most 9% across layouts (threshold 20%) and no perturbed layout leaves any perch-box point under 3 cameras. Tape-measure positions are good enough for this conclusion.
